## Summary

- What changed?
- Why does it help the project?

## Type of change

- [ ] Content
- [ ] GitHub setup
- [ ] Website/showcase
- [ ] Partnership/process
- [ ] Security or access

## Checks

- [ ] No secrets or private credentials were added
- [ ] Public wording is accurate and not overstated
- [ ] Links were checked if new links were added
- [ ] The change is focused and does not mix unrelated work
